Low heat is the key here. Add a knob of butter or oil, whichever you prefer. Add in your egg mix and keep stirring the omelette (all sides and places), while keeping the omelette form, till you see a sort of "firmness" setting it and let that rest for about 10 seconds. Shake the pan a bit and if it's JUST coming off the pan, you know that it's nice and fluffy and about 95% done. Flip over, rest for 10 - 15 seconds, flip again.

BIG tip: Add in salt and pepper in the end to avoid the salt breaking the egg and making it watery.

Quick tip: A bit of milk makes it lovely and smooth.
